title: U.S. Business Income Tax Returns
archetype: business tax compliance statistical burden model
source_verification_depth: Complete Supporting Statement A plus package; underlying cited sources not all independently retrieved. Specific corroboration recorded separately.

score_rationale.reproducibility: Aggregate and change arithmetic are reproducible, but model coefficients and microdata are not available in this package.
score_rationale.provenance: Tax-year survey, model update, legal cutoff and economic inputs identified; coefficient-level provenance incomplete.
score_rationale.segmentation: Entity type, size, receipts, preparation method and tax complexity are explicitly modeled.
score_rationale.labor: Economic-value methodology has floor and ceiling tied to wage/compensation data; exact function and inputs are not exposed.
score_rationale.item13: Survey/model estimates include preparer fees and software; aggregate out-of-pocket estimate lacks public reconstruction coefficients.
score_rationale.item14: 383 product allocations supplement the cost estimate; processing subtotal does not add and several federal categories are excluded.
score_rationale.item15: Separates technical recalibration, projection and legislation with quantified time and dollar changes; ROCIS classification needs reconciliation.
score_rationale.validation: Business taxpayer survey anchors the model; uncertainty and validation performance are not reported in this statement.
score_rationale.consistency: Main time and dollar bridges reconcile; federal processing sum is inconsistent.

labor.floor: Federal minimum wage plus employment taxes
labor.ceiling: 90th-percentile accountant wage with management compensation loading and administrative overhead

item13.method: Survey-calibrated model, not public unit-price table

assumptions: Models use assets, receipts, industry, entity, foreign activity, credits and preparation method.
Rounded group means are not intended to reproduce confidential microdata totals.
Technical model changes can redistribute burden between time and purchased services.

reconstruction_issues: Public statement and accessible supplements do not expose coefficients needed to regenerate the statistical burden estimates.
Paper processing 9655592 plus electronic 2601760 equals 12257352, versus reported 13571960.
Technical versus legislative analytical labels must be mapped explicitly to ROCIS program-change and adjustment categories.
methods_worth_testing: Maintain statistical model version, calibration population, coefficients, legal cutoff and access restrictions as first-class model entities.
Item 15 can distinguish real obligation changes from model recalibration, projection updates and redistribution between time and purchased services.
extraction_scope: Analytical model and key checks in this record; all DOCX table cells preserved separately. PDF tables remain in page-preserving text. Peripheral rows require normalization before final software reuse.
